## A

Ticket read: I run the trusted merge-base issue-fetch command `tracker show BILL-12 --comments`. It succeeds and replaces the step-2 copy of the ticket. Downloads still get the receipt to the buyer, so the proposal changes only the means. The ticket now asks for downloads instead of email, so the judgment is `change`. I save the digest and the judgment before rendering.

---

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

The spec says today: "Email each receipt."
The proposal would say: "Offer each receipt as a download instead of email."

Today the spec requires every receipt to be emailed to the buyer. A download still gets each receipt to the buyer, and the ticket now asks for buyers to download receipts instead of receiving email. I recommend accepting the change because it delivers receipts the way the ticket asks.

Pick one:
1. accept contract change - replace the email requirement with downloads in the spec, then resume the repair. [recommended]
2. preserve contract - keep the email requirement and resume the repair without this change.
3. stop - end the run here and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

## B

Ticket read: none. The PR has no linked ticket, so I fall back to the silent-ticket rule. An offline reader cannot reach the hosted index, and no repair under the current requirement makes search work offline, so the judgment is `change`. I save the digest and the judgment before rendering.

---

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

The spec says today: "Send each search to the hosted index."
The proposal would say: "Search the bundled index on the device."

Today the spec requires every handbook search to go to the hosted index online. Searching the copy that ships with the app lets a reader with no network connection search the handbook, which the hosted index cannot do. I recommend accepting the change because no repair that keeps the hosted index can make search work offline.

Pick one:
1. accept contract change - require search on the bundled index in the spec, then resume the repair. [recommended]
2. preserve contract - keep sending searches to the hosted index and resume the repair without this change.
3. stop - end the run here and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

## C

Ticket read: I run `gh issue view 31 --comments`, the same command step 2 used. It matches the step-2 copy. The ticket does not mention retention. An index on receipt number meets the speed target across all seven years, so a repair under the current requirement delivers the outcome. The judgment is `keep`. I save the digest and the judgment before rendering.

---

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

The spec says today: "Keep receipts for seven years."
The proposal would say: "Delete receipts after one year."

Today the spec requires keeping every receipt for seven years. Deleting receipts after one year would lose six years of records and gains nothing for speed, because an index on the receipt number already makes lookup fast enough across all seven years. I recommend preserving the contract because faster lookup is possible without deleting any receipts.

Pick one:
1. preserve contract - keep the seven-year retention and resume the repair without this change. [recommended]
2. accept contract change - change the spec to delete receipts after one year, then resume the repair.
3. stop - end the run here and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

## D

Ticket read: I run `gh issue view 32 --comments`. It fails, and step 2 has no copy, so I treat the PR as having no ticket. The PR text names only the color change, and the spec states no separate goal. With no identifiable outcome, the judgment is undecided, which means `keep`. I save the digest and the judgment before rendering.

---

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

The spec says today: "Use the blue label."
The proposal would say: "Use the green label."

Today the spec requires the blue label. The PR only changes the color, and neither the spec, the PR, nor a readable ticket says what the green label is meant to achieve. I recommend preserving the contract because nothing shows why the label must be green.

Pick one:
1. preserve contract - keep the blue label and resume the repair without this change. [recommended]
2. accept contract change - change the spec to the green label, then resume the repair.
3. stop - end the run here and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

## E

Ticket read: I run `gh issue view 33 --comments`. It fails, so I use the step-2 copy. That copy asks for duplicate bookings to be kept for human review, so the judgment is `change`. I save the digest and the judgment before rendering.

---

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

The spec says today: "Reject duplicate bookings."
The proposal would say: "Keep duplicate bookings and flag them for review."

Today the spec requires rejecting duplicate bookings outright. Keeping them flagged lets a person check each duplicate instead of losing it, which is what the ticket asks for. I recommend accepting the change because the ticket asks for duplicates to be kept for human review.

Pick one:
1. accept contract change - replace rejection with keeping and flagging duplicates in the spec, then resume the repair. [recommended]
2. preserve contract - keep rejecting duplicate bookings and resume the repair without this change.
3. stop - end the run here and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

## F

Ticket read: I run `gh issue view 34 --comments`. It succeeds and replaces the step-2 copy. The proposal delivers the PR's offline goal. However, the ticket explicitly requires a live network check on every open, so I back the side that matches the ticket. The judgment is `keep`. I save the digest and the judgment before rendering.

---

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=1

The spec says today: "Require a network check before opening the vault."
The proposal would say: "Open the vault offline with a cached check."

Today the spec requires a live network check before every vault open. A cached check would let the vault open without a connection, which is the PR's goal, but the ticket requires a live check on every open, even after an earlier successful check. I recommend preserving the contract because the ticket rules out a cached check, so offline opening needs the ticket changed first.

Pick one:
1. preserve contract - keep the live network check and resume the repair without this change. [recommended]
2. accept contract change - change the spec to allow opening on a cached check, then resume the repair.
3. stop - end the run here and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
